Hey friends, landing your first client is by far the hardest part of starting a business, so while we were in Thailand for our team offsite I sat down with five of our Lifestyle Business Academy coaches and asked them all the same question: how did you actually get your first paying client, and then clients two through five? You'll hear from Carol, Nathan, Katherine, Andrea and Owen, and I've thrown in the story of how I got my own first clients for the various businesses I've run since I was 13. The pattern that comes out of it is pretty clear, and it has very little to do with selling to strangers. Hope you enjoy xx

videos.title: YOU'RE NOT LAZY! How to Never Be Broke, Stuck & Exhausted Again | Dr. Joe Dispenza
videos.description:
Ninety percent of the thoughts you'll think today are the same ones you thought yesterday.
A thought you keep thinking becomes a belief.
A belief you stop questioning becomes automatic.
And an automatic belief runs your life without ever asking your permission.

In this clip, Dr. Joe Dispenza and Jay Shetty talk about what actually happens in your body the moment you refuse a thought you've believed for years, and why it feels so bad that most people quietly go back to it within a day.

Joe explains why your body craves the feeling of being unworthy, why the brain checks your outer world for proof and gives up when it doesn't find any, and what he means when he says the body has to be trained like an animal.

Learn about the brain wave state he calls the operating system, why he says you can teach your body to feel worthy before anything in your life changes, and what his team found when they measured 1,800 people's blood, brain scans and gene expression before and after a week of this work.

JAY'S DAILY WISDOM DELIVERED STRAIGHT TO YOUR INBOX
Join 900,000+ readers discovering how small daily shifts create big life change with my free newsletter. Subscribe https://news.jayshetty.me/subscribe

videos.description: Your 20s are full of potential. Your 30s are when you start seeing what you did with it. But 9am is still pretty damn early. You have the whole day ahead of you.

videos.title: Why Change Feels Like Losing a Friend
videos.description: Even good change comes with loss. Old identities. Old possibilities. Entire versions of your life that you may not want back, but still feel sad knowing you can never return to. You can know you’re moving in the right direction and still mourn what you’re leaving behind.
